name: The Local Kitchen
signature_dish: Siddu with ghee and walnut chutney
must_try: Siddu (steamed wheat bun stuffed with poppy seed/walnut)
why_it_matters: The closest sit-down kitchen serving genuine Kullu-Banjar Himachali food rather than the cafe-menu thalis at the homestays. Siddu and madra are made fresh in the morning, not reheated; the kitchen is small enough that the cook will adjust spice on request.
insider_tip: Order siddu 30 minutes before you want it — they steam it to order. Kullu Dham (the seven-course no-onion-no-garlic festival meal) needs a full day's notice and minimum four people.
signature_address: Main Bazaar, Banjar, Kullu District, Himachal Pradesh 175123
